chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on converting pretrained standard LLMs into linear recurrent structures without adding extra parameters, which is the core definition of this category.
The paper introduces Liger Attention and transforms standard attention into linear recurrent structures, which inherently reduces the quadratic complexity of the original transformer.
The paper evaluates the linearized models on multiple benchmarks to ensure performance recovery, aligning with the investigation of efficient architectures for reasoning tasks.
